original_text:
I moved out of the data analytics field (And this is NOT an advice). 

After spending ~7 years in analytics, I learned, made mistakes, and grew with projects.

But as I gained experience and started climbing the corporate ladder, I felt a NEED to change - to explore, more in-demand skills that the market values today. (you know the reason)

That’s what pulled me towards the Gen AI + Engineering space.

Learning tools like Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Databricks, YAML, and Large Language Models (LLMs) opened gates.

In the analytics space, I was circling around SQL, Tableau, and Alteryx only. Great tools, but the growth path started feeling...limited.

Not saying this is the right move for you. Your decision depends on:
 → how many years of experience you have
 → what tools you enjoy working with
 → and above all, your curiosity to explore 

What’s your take on the Data Analytics field today? Or are you exploring Gen AI / Engineering too?

#dataanalytics #engineering #genAI

ai_analysis.summary: A personal reflection about leaving data analytics after approximately seven years to explore Gen AI and engineering. The author mentions exposure to Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Databricks, YAML, large language models, SQL, Tableau, and Alteryx, but provides no technical instruction or detailed technical knowledge.
